author: michalsitarik
quote:
Things a liked:
1: This is the best looking game ever.
2: The world is full of detail and life.
3: Soundtracks are phenomenal.
Things i didn't like:
1: The performance of the game on base PS5 is catastrofic. (24-28fps in the big city)
2: Game is full of bugs and glitches(falling trought the world for example)
3. Horible boring mission that are just filler.
4. Pacing of the game is worse than anybody would expect.
5. You can not steal luxury cars for the long period of the game.
4. You can carry only few weapons.
6. Main characters are soulless and deeply uninteresting.( LUCIA is to agressive for no reason and JASON is too passive)
7. Karma/Honor system does not work in a GTA game.
8. This is not a GTA game but a dating simulator.
9. Game does not have AUTOSAVE a basic feature.
10. UI is worse than in a previous games.
11. A lot of features are locked behind ULTIMATE EDTION of the game (paywall)

I expected to have a fun in this game but i didn't.
This game was not made for the fans of the gta series.
They replaced every fun feature for the sake of realism.
Gta series was not fun because of realism.
Gta series was fun because of unapologetic characters, satire and goofy humor.
This not a GTA game but a RELATIONSHIP SIMULATOR.
They realy removed GTA part from GTA.
